[[Voldo the Exotic]] crafts armor for [[core]] professions using the [[Tyrian armor]] art and [[Factions]] professions using the [[Exotic armor]] art. Voldo also crafts [[Ranger masks|Ranger]], [[Monk scalp designs|Monk]], [[Necromancer scar patterns|Necromancer]] and [[Mesmer masks|Mesmer]] Prophecies headgear art and also [[Elementalist headgear#Factions headgear art|Elementalist auras]]. All armor is crafted with a blank [[insignia slot]].

==Trivia==
* This character's name and his connection with "exotic" armor may have been taken from [[w:Voldo|Voldo]], a character in the [[w:Soul Calibur|Soul Calibur]] series who was charged with guarding his master's treasure in a hidden vault.
